newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 22.

text.p: The Washington Post carries the following major business stories on January 22:
WASHINGTON - Federal Reserve Board Chairman Alan Greenspan said the economy is still vigorous with few signs of inflation. That means stable interest rates for now, investors and analysts said.
WASHINGTON - AutoNation USA, moving rapidly to establish a national chain of automotive superstores, plans to open a facility in Woodbridge, Va.

WASHINGTON - First Maryland Bancorp of Baltimore announced that its parent company, Allied Irish Banks of Dublin, has agreed to pay $1.36 billion in cash and stock for Dauphin Deposit Corp., a Pennsylvania bank company.
WASHINGTON - Lockheed Martin Corp. reported that its 1996 profit rose to $1.3 billion.

WASHINGTON - Crisis prevention activity has become one of the IMF's most important missions in an era when foreign investors acting en masse can turn an "emerging market" into a financial basket case with a few computer keystrokes.
